descriptor.excerpt:
/// The backing descriptor type for [`crate::View`].
///
/// Constructing a descriptor never touches LVGL. Application and component
/// functions return [`crate::View`] and use ordinary constructors such as
/// [`crate::column`], [`crate::label`] and [`crate::button`].
pub struct Node<M> {
    pub(crate) key: Key,
    pub(crate) kind: WidgetKind,
    pub(crate) style: Style,
    pub(crate) part_styles: Vec<(Selector, Style)>,
    pub(crate) keyboard_id: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) grid_cell: Option<GridCell>,
    pub(crate) children: Vec<Node<M>>,
    pub(crate) handlers: HandlerSet<M>,
    pub(crate) clickable: Option<bool>,
    pub(crate) scrollable: Option<bool>,
    pub(crate) checked: Option<bool>,
    pub(crate) interaction: crate::scroll::Interaction,
    pub(crate) animations: Vec<crate::Animation>,
    #[cfg(feature = "input-keypad")]
    pub(crate) focusable: Option<bool>,
    #[cfg(feature = "input-keypad")]
    pub(crate) modal: bool,
    #[cfg(feature = "input-gridnav")]
    pub(crate) grid_navigation: Option<crate::GridNavigation>,
}

features.excerpt:
[features]
# `alloc` is the only capability required on bare-metal targets. It enables the
# allocator-aware parts of the `rs_lvgl` crate; `rs_lvgl_ui` itself always requires
# `alloc`.
default = ["alloc", "components", "widgets-all", "fonts-vendored"]
alloc = ["rs_lvgl/alloc"]
# Composite components (`rs_lvgl_ui::components`): lists, panels, stack
# navigation, dialogs and toasts built from plain nodes.
components = []
input-keypad = ["rs_lvgl/input-keypad"]
input-gridnav = ["input-keypad", "rs_lvgl_sys/gridnav"]
# Host acceptance harness; requires the dedicated BUILTIN allocator config.
# This does not select an allocator or change production defaults.
leak-check = [
    "alloc", "components", "widgets-all", "fonts-vendored", "input-gridnav",
    "widget-qrcode", "widget-barcode", "widget-gif", "widget-lottie",
    "widget-ime-pinyin", "font-cjk-16",
]

# Widgets. Obj, row, column, grid, label, button and custom nodes are always
# available; every other view constructor needs its `widget-*` feature.
# LVGL compiles only the enabled widgets (plus the ones they build on), so
# disabling unused ones shrinks the firmware. `widgets-all` also keeps the
# LVGL widgets that have no node (list, menu, win) for raw `rs_lvgl_sys`
# use; with it disabled, enable them through `rs_lvgl_sys/widget-*`.

extensions.excerpt:
# Optional extensions are separate from widgets-all to preserve defaults.
widget-qrcode = ["rs_lvgl_sys/widget-qrcode"]
widget-barcode = ["rs_lvgl_sys/widget-barcode"]
widget-gif = ["rs_lvgl_sys/widget-gif"]
widget-lottie = ["rs_lvgl_sys/widget-lottie"]
widget-ime-pinyin = ["rs_lvgl_sys/widget-ime-pinyin", "widget-keyboard"]
font-cjk-14 = ["rs_lvgl_sys/font-cjk-14"]
font-cjk-16 = ["rs_lvgl_sys/font-cjk-16"]
